{{Top|leg}}
'''Heavy gravity-conductive nets''' were [[Ssi-ruu]]k technology used to immobilize and incapacitate enemy prisoners. Fitted in the secondary landing bays of [[Sh'ner-class planetary assault carrier|''Sh'ner''-class planetary assault carriers]], the heavy gravity-conductive nets were used alongside [[stun trap]]s and [[microtractor-beam generator]]s to subdue the crews when enemy [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] were captured in combat.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
